confessions.text: I truly believe I will never be loved.
I'm worried that everyone I love finds everything I do annoying and dreads talking to me. They reassure me and tell me they don't, but deep down I struggle to believe them.

I always felt alone. Even if I was right there with people I felt disconnected in a way. People would ask if I was okay a lot but I don't know what I was supposed to say, because to be honest I wasn't and I'm still not.
Most of the time, I feel lonely. Yeah, I have friends who like me, I love all my friends, but no one ever asks me to hang out. I just want people to value me the way I value them.
I feel like a floater friend.
I feel like I'm always helping everyone else but no one ever helps or at least asks me. I'm tired of being the therapist friend because really I need help sometimes too.

I have this nagging fear that everyone I'm friends with dislikes me or pities me. I always get reassured when I talk about it, but the fear never really goes away. It's hard to be with people when you feel out of place all the time.
I feel like I can't find my people, I just want someone who gets ME for who I am. I sit there at night staring at the blank ceiling wondering: if I can't be loved by my friends, how do I love myself?
I feel like I am nobody's friend. I consider them mine but I don't think any of them really know. They don't reach out.
I feel like it can be hard to maintain a balance between trying to be successful in my extracurriculars and my academics, then add trying to maintain friendships and everything seems to fall apart.

Everyone expects you to have everything figured out while balancing school work and personal appearances, like getting the perfect score and perfect social life all at once. That's overwhelming sometimes but you can't say that, you just smile and suck it up.

I feel so stupid and like I won't get anywhere in life. My parents put so much pressure on me and nothing I do ever feels good enough. My friends can't relate since they're all so smart, so I can't talk to anyone either.

I live with the fear that I will never be enough for the program, despite all of my effort, because somehow I'm still mediocre at everything. Trying to be good enough is so awful and I feel like I'm falling behind so hard.
When I don't understand something in school I hide it from my teachers so I'm not viewed as stupid. When I'm struggling I'm scared to show my pain to others and suffer through it alone.
I want all the people at school to know how much I'm struggling, so that they can understand why I act the way I do, but it feels like attention seeking if I tell them.
I'm gay and my parents are Christian so I can't tell them.
I've been bisexual for a couple years now, and I have no idea how to tell my parents.
I feel so guilty because I breathe easier when I am away from my house. I love my family, I just feel relief and not anxious when I am not around my dad.
I'm a single child and my parents love me, still I feel unloved sometimes, as if my existence doesn't matter to them.
Sometimes my parents make me feel like I'm a failure or a burden to be with them. I wish I could be better for them but my mental health is making things very hard.
My dad's political views are so crappy but I gave up fighting him about it, so I just listen and don't fight and feel so guilty.
It is so confusing having a loving yet toxic mom. Like she does everything for me but also gave me hard times and memories I wish I didn't remember.
I don't open up to my parents. I'm afraid of what they'll say, because they immediately start yelling at me. I've become the version of myself they wanna see.
I would like to come out to my mom but I don't know how she would react, and I don't want her to see me in a different way and I don't want it to ruin our relationship.
My worst fear in life is not being able to give back to my parents for their sacrifices. What do I matter if I turn out to be a disappointment, or if I don't exceed their expectations for me?
Sometimes I feel like a really bad daughter but at the same time I know my parents could try better as well and they don't. When I tell them how I feel we always end up arguing and I end up crying.
I really miss my ex best friend, we'd been friends for 12 years before we fell apart. She often comes in my dreams, a dream of us being besties again.
When I lose friends I reminisce about them constantly and it makes me feel weak, like I can't get over them the way they got over me.
I wish I could change the stuff I did sophomore year. I lost so many friends and I regret it. I want to be able to apologize to those people even if I couldn't get an acceptance from them.
I miss my ex-friend. I broke it off but part of me regrets it, feels like I overreacted. I just miss her and wonder if she misses me.

I miss my ex best friend who cut things off with me almost a year ago. She influenced me so much, all my cool interests and music I listen to. I know I can't fix our relationship but I don't know how to let go.
I did something I shouldn't of and I think I messed up one of the best friendships I've ever had and I regret it so much.

I hate the way no matter how present and caring my friends are, my mind is always preparing for them to leave me. It's like my brain cannot accept that I can have healthy and stable relationships with people anymore.
I hate how my friends treat me like I'm a ghost. They only come to me whenever they need advice or someone to talk to.
I feel annoying to all of my friends. Even when they reach out to talk to me I am always hesitant because I don't want them to end up being annoyed by the end of the conversation.
Sometimes I talk with my friends and when they go silent it's awkward because then I'm in my head about what I said and it makes me feel like I've crossed a line.
I know she's moved on already. But I still love her. I miss her so much that it hurts.
Me and my ex broke up 6 months ago and I told my friends I've moved on, but I still catch myself thinking about him daily, missing him.
I don't even miss my ex really, I just miss having someone love or even like me, because no one else ever does; why would they?
The girl I've liked for a year has no idea, and I just had to third wheel her and this guy that she likes. I thought she felt the same way. Seeing them together hurt so much.
It was just a week but I still think about her every day. That's really dumb. Because it was only a week.
I'm realizing that my boyfriend breaking up with me was for the better and that really hurts. I really just liked the title and having someone I could talk to, even if they didn't listen.

I'm the only one in my friend group who hasn't had a boyfriend in like the past two years. I just smile and pretend I'm ecstatic about being single when in reality I wonder if a guy will ever actually love me.
I yearn for a relationship so much but when people who feel that way about me try and get close I always end up pushing them away. I regret it every time.
I sometimes wish I didn't feel the need to always be okay. Like I always have to say "I'm fine" but I'm not always freaking fine. I need help but I don't always know how to ask for it.
I pretend everything is okay, that since I'm a guy I'm tough and "always good". But that's a lie. I feel like a "project" that needs to get fixed instead of a human being.
I feel like I can't tell anyone how I feel. I've been keeping up this act of being fine and always happy for so long that I feel like I can't stop.
All the time, I hide just how tired and hopeless I feel and replace it with a smile just so I don't worry those who care about me, even though it only adds to the sadness I feel.
Whenever someone asks me to hang out I say yes, not because I want to but because I want to put out the image that I'm fine and have the energy. I'm just so tired of it.
I say stuff I don't mean or agree with to fit in, and I hate it SO MUCH.
I know my friends from school don't understand any of my interests but I pretend to like theirs so they don't reject me, so I feel like a pathetic puppy following them around.
I wish someone would ask if I'm okay and actually mean it. I want to be understood, not fixed.
I feel like I want to fit in so badly and make friends that now I feel like I lost my personality and don't know who I am anymore. I'm scared I'll never get my personality back.

I often fear my future so SO much. I'm afraid of the friends I might make or not make, and the mistakes and choices I'll make or not, and all the things I have hope for, I'm afraid they might not happen.

Everyone around me has a dream job. But when adults ask me about my dream job, how do I tell them that my only dream is to travel, be rich, free and happy. I feel like not having a particular direction is wasting my potential.

I'm worried that there isn't anything good about me, and that I'm a failure before my life really starts. Everyone else my age can drive and have jobs and are applying for schools, and I'm just stuck.
I feel like I've wasted my teenage years due to my mental health. Now I'm 18 but I feel like I'm not finished being a child yet.
I got told that people think I'm not trustworthy enough to do my dream job. I've dreamed of this since I was little. These comments make me rethink everything.
